topic: Analyzing sensor data and antenna relocation impact
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing traffic trends and the impact of antenna relocation across multiple malls. It was noted that general traffic decline could be due to shifts from real-world to local activity.

Regarding sensor data, specific observations were made for Diepsloot Mall (loss of weak sessions on all 3 sensors) and Kings William Mall (general session count likely increased despite signal anomalies).

It was concluded that antenna relocation generally helped improve traffic metrics across most sensors, although the timing comparison was difficult due to Black Friday.

Multiple malls identified as potentially problematic for further analysis include Bara Mall, Eyethu Orange Farm, Lephalale Crossing Mall, Nyanga Junction Mall, Tshwane Mall, and Umlazi Mega City. The client is requested to perform the same antenna relocation analysis in these listed malls for all sensors.

For data filtering, a minimum signal level of 89 was established when performing a check/hashcheck.
decisions: The client will conduct an antenna relocation impact analysis in Bara Mall, Eyethu Orange Farm, Lephalale Crossing Mall, Nyanga Junction Mall, Tshwane Mall, and Umlazi Mega City for all sensors.
When checking sensor data (hashcheck), the minimum signal level used is 89.
action_items: The client should provide the exact date of antenna relocation for each listed mall.
